claim: ClassificationSmoothing uses majority analysis with explicit odd KERNEL_SIZE. The local native 3x3 branch has been executed and its changed pixel distribution must be reported separately from accuracy.
preconditions: Input is a classification raster with frozen class codes
limitations: Smoothing can remove narrow or small classes
Do not equate smoother appearance with higher accuracy
Do not substitute this task for Sieve or Clump
